title: Different from Allure subscription
text: I receive 8 subs a month. Allure is one of my favorites because the other boxes seem to all give out the same brands in the same month. I watched some of the reviews that said they were disappointed.  If you regularly buy quality skincare, you know "Full Size" especially for eye products are usually half an ounce. So, no those aren't samples those are actually full size. My problem with Allure though is that they give great sign up boxes but don't seem to want to keep the already customer happy. I've also received duplicates when they claim that you won't.  Another thing is subscribing through Amazon is a lot easier to stop your subscription when you decide to. What sucks is that you're not able to get the special priced members boxes they offer. I'd give 5 stars straight across if the price didn't increase . Sometimes it's an awesome box and some months are "eh, decent I guess"
label: positive
